name: A Foundation Report: Family Violence
description:
This dataset is a 2018 foundation report on family violence in New York City, broken down by community district and borough. It contains 74 rows and 46 columns. The main records cover the five boroughs (Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Manhattan, and Staten Island) and 25 community district categories, including an "Unknown" and a "Total" entry.

Most columns report counts of family-violence incidents and related measures. These include domestic incident reports (fam_dir), family and domestic-violence felony assaults (fam_fel_assault, dv_fel_assault), and family and domestic-violence rapes (fam_rape, dv_rape). A large block of columns holds citywide summary figures that appear only once in the data (about 98.65% missing), covering totals by relationship type (child, parent, other relative), homicide counts by relationship, sex, prior domestic incident history, and method (blunt force, sharp instrument, firearm).
